notes.meaning: Michael, the guardian angel of God’s people, rises to defend them during an unprecedented time of hardship. Even though this distress is terrible, God will deliver his people—everyone whose name is recorded in his book. God assures his faithful that he remains in control and will protect them through every trial.

differ.view: This time of distress points specifically to the future Great Tribulation just before Christ returns.
This trouble points to the siege of Jerusalem and spans the whole era between Christ's first and second coming.

notes.meaning: The dead will physically rise from their graves at the last day. The righteous will enter into everlasting life, while the ungodly will face lasting shame and dishonor. God gives this promise to bring comfort to believers who face death for their faith.

differ.view: This awakening describes a first resurrection of believers before a thousand-year reign, while the wicked remain dead until later.

notes.meaning: Believers who live in true wisdom and honor God will receive radiant glory in eternity. God gives special honor to those who lead others into righteous living, making them shine like stars forever. Faithful service to the Lord brings an enduring heavenly reward.

Daniel is commanded to protect the written prophecy and keep it safe until God's appointed time. As the end draws near, people will search the scriptures with great care, and understanding of God's purpose will increase. The message was preserved so it would bring clarity when its fulfillment arrived.

Daniel looks and sees two other heavenly messengers standing on opposite banks of the Tigris River. They appear as divine witnesses to confirm that God's promises are true and certain. Their presence shows that heaven is attentively watching over God's unfolding plan.

One of the angels speaks to the majestic figure dressed in linen who hovers above the river waters. The angel asks how long it will be before these astonishing events reach their conclusion. Even heavenly beings eagerly desire to understand God's timetable for delivering his people.

The figure in linen lifts both hands toward heaven to swear a solemn oath by the living God. He states that the trials will last for a time, times, and half a time, meaning a set and limited period. When the power of God's people seems completely broken, their troubles will finally end and God will bring victory.

differ.view: The phrase represents a literal period of three and a half years during the final tribulation.
The phrase represents an indefinite, symbolic period of church history rather than literal years.

notes.meaning: Daniel hears the angel's answer clearly, but he does not understand what the timeline means. He asks the heavenly figure what the final outcome of these wonders will be. His question shows that even a great prophet depended entirely on God for spiritual insight into the future.

The messenger tells Daniel to go on with his life in peace without worrying about further details. The meaning of the prophecy is closed and sealed until the time of its fulfillment arrives. God gives his servants only what is necessary for faithful obedience in their own day.

Severe trials will purify and cleanse God's people, removing impurities like fire refining precious metal. Meanwhile, the wicked will continue in their evil ways, completely blind to what God is doing. Those who follow God with wisdom will understand his purpose in suffering and stand firm.

differ.view: The refining process shows how God uses afflictions to sanctify his church and completely deliver believers from sin.

notes.meaning: The angel gives a count of 1,290 days from the stopping of daily temple sacrifices to the setup of a defiling idol. This specific number reassures believers that the reign of wickedness is strictly limited by God. Even when pure worship is suppressed, God keeps count of every day of oppression.

differ.view: This desecration occurred when Roman forces destroyed the Jerusalem temple in AD 70 after Christ fulfilled all sacrifices.
This counts a literal future period after the Antichrist desecrates a rebuilt temple in the end times.

notes.meaning: God promises a special blessing to anyone who perseveres and reaches 1,335 days. This extra waiting period shows that full restoration and joy take time beyond the end of persecution. Those who patiently hold on to faith will witness God's complete deliverance.

differ.view: The additional forty-five days represent an interval when Christ judges the earth and prepares the millennial kingdom.

notes.meaning: The angel gives Daniel a final word of comfort, telling him to live faithfully until his life ends. Daniel will rest peacefully in death and then rise again in the bodily resurrection at the end of days. There he will receive his eternal share in God's kingdom, just like an allotment of land in the Promised Land.
